description: This file defines an authentication API router using FastAPI framework, including endpoints for user signup, login, and retrieving current user information. It includes route handlers, documentation, and dependencies for database access and user management.

classes.description: Pydantic schema for representing user data excluding sensitive information.

classes.description: Pydantic schema for user login credentials.
